```{r}
bestseller_21<-read_csv("../bestseller21.csv")
bestseller_22<-read_csv("../bestseller22.csv")
bestseller_23<-read_csv("../bestseller23.csv")
bestseller_24<-read_csv("bestseller24.csv")
reviews <- read_csv("../book_reviews.csv")
```

```{r}

average_rate_data <- reviews%>%
  group_by(isbn)%>%
  mutate(average_rate=mean(stars))%>% 
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(review_length = str_length(review_text))

unique_book_bestseller <- bestseller%>%
  group_by(primary_isbn10)%>%
  mutate(highest_rank = min(rank),
            .groups = "drop")%>% 
  ungroup()%>%
  select(-rank)%>%
  select(-rank_last_week)%>%
  unique()
  

```


```{r}
#join the bestsellers
bigseller <- bestseller_24 %>% 
  full_join(bestseller_23) %>% 
  full_join(bestseller_22) %>% 
  full_join(bestseller_21) %>% 
  select(-primary_isbn13)
```


```{r}
write_csv(unique_book_bestseller, "primarycleaned_bestseller_data.csv")

```


```{r}
write_csv(average_rate_data, "primarycleaned_reviews_data.csv")
```


```{r}
write_csv(bigseller, "full_bestseller.csv")
```
